title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 08, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: High (M3.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.6 (Peaked October 08, 2026 at 00:59 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 352 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: X-Ray Flux exceeded M5

The Sun's waking up! ☀️🌌

A bright active region is standing out prominently on the solar disk today, while the coronagraph shows ordinary streamer structure.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
